title: GrowthBook closing call to action (v2)
description: A wide navy card with rounded corners: a 48px headline, a short reassuring line and violet + outline buttons on the left, a glowing art slot on the right. A thin outline behind the card drifts as you scroll and a bright segment glides back and forth along its edge. On phones the card sits on a violet-to-mint wash with the art above the text.
notes: the card always uses the theme's dark colours (dark class)
CSS only; the drifting outline and gliding segment stop under reduced motion
